evidence: Start: Incident Report, Detailed Description of Impact; customers in the EU multi-region lost reservation and autoscaling ability beginning 20:13 Pacific on 20 November. | End: Mini Incident Report gives incident end 05:50 Pacific on 21 November; the Incident Report says mitigation was complete then. | Regions: Affected location and both reports name only the EU multi-region.
notes: Location is the Google Cloud multi-region eu, which is not a region, so no region code and scope unclear. Published date is the Incident Report post of 23 Nov 2023 18:48 PST (2023-11-24 02:48 UTC). Start taken from the final Incident Report (20:13 PST); the header and Mini Incident Report give 20:00 PST (2023-11-21T04:00Z). A status update says resolved as of 05:34 PST. Times converted from PST (UTC-8). Only Google BigQuery (Workload Management) named as impaired.

evidence: Start: Mini Incident Report lists incident start as 08:00 Pacific on 12 March 2024. | End: Mini Incident Report lists incident end as 14:55 Pacific the same day, about seven hours later. | Regions: Mini Incident Report says every region and zone offering GPUs was affected; the location list names forty regions.
notes: Scope coded global because the report says all GPU regions and zones for the affected feature. Regions are the 40 listed in previously affected locations. Times converted from PDT (UTC-7; DST began 10 Mar 2024). A status update says resolved as of 15:09 PDT (22:09Z). Only Google Kubernetes Engine named as impaired; NVIDIA drivers are a partner dependency, not a counted product.

evidence: Start: Incident Report, Summary; GCP and Workspace products saw raised latency and errors in us-east1 from 07:50 Pacific on 18 July 2025. | End: Incident Report gives GCP impact ending 09:47 Pacific, when connectivity was restored and services stabilized. | Regions: Incident Report says us-east1 products were hit, worst in zone us-east1-b, other regions unaffected.
